name: Celia Roberts
reason: Health rule: her school, the BioMedical Institute of Yoga and Meditation (biyome.com.au), frames almost everything as medicine or therapy (lifestyle medicine, yoga therapy, BioMedical meditation therapy, embodied medicine, medicine-assisted and psychedelic-assisted therapy, a 'treatment centre'), and even the meditation teacher trainings are presented through lifestyle medicine; very little would pass the strict health and 'anything medical' rules.
